description: The struggle over the Outpost expands into Blackblood politics, the Kinj infection and Yavalla's rise, forcing Talon and her allies into increasingly desperate choices over power, family and survival.

s03e01.description: Talon struggles to preserve peace while Zed forces humans into a mining camp, a brilliant newcomer invades Janzo's laboratory and a dark priestess rallies the Blackbloods.

s03e02.description: Wren and Janzo work on a mysterious puzzle box, Tobin and Munt seek outside help and Talon learns a painful secret about the person who abandoned her.

s03e03.description: Talon, Wren, Janzo and Yavalla enter a deadly labyrinth in search of an ancient relic while Gwynn and Zed battle for control of the Outpost.

s03e04.description: Yavalla draws Gwynn toward her cause, Tobin is reunited with a former love and Zed's loyalty is tested as Talon presses for answers.

s03e05.description: Tobin returns with an army and a concealed agenda, and a confrontation in the throne room leaves the Outpost with deaths, prisoners and a new commander.

s03e06.description: Talon creates a sanctuary for the infected while Janzo and Wren hunt for a cure and Garret investigates a cult carrying out human sacrifices.

s03e07.description: Yavalla, Gwynn and Tobin seize the Capital with Talon, Garret and Zed pursuing them, while an unexpected Prime Order brute takes refuge at the Outpost.

s03e08.description: Talon confronts the possibility that death may be the only way to save her friends as the Outpost becomes an arena and an old enemy releases a dangerous power.

s03e09.description: Gwynn learns Tobin's secret, Talon discovers a long-lost deadly power and rival groups hunt Yavalla for very different reasons.

s03e10.description: Wren confronts Yavalla while Janzo, Talon and Zed attempt an assassination and Tobin's divided loyalties threaten the mission.

s03e11.description: Falista's anger collides with Gwynn over Tobin, Janzo exposes a fraudulent cure and Talon searches for answers about her father.

s03e12.description: Talon and Zed uncover painful truths about their families while Tobin attempts a heroic rescue and the Outpost prepares for Yavalla's growing horde.

s03e13.description: The Outpost is overrun, Talon and Zed return with an unexpected ally and the defenders conclude that only a major sacrifice can prevent total defeat.
